1.english_reference: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem

traditions.KJV: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem ,

1.english_reference: and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof

traditions.WLC: וּ רְאוּ נָ֤א וּ דְעוּ֙ וּ בַקְשׁ֣וּ בִ רְחוֹבוֹתֶ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἴδετε καὶ γνῶτε καὶ ζητήσατε ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: et aspícite , et consideráte , et quǽrite in platéis eius ,
traditions.KJV: and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof ,

1.english_reference: if ye can find a man

traditions.KJV: if ye can find a man ,

1.english_reference: if there be [ any ] that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth

traditions.WLC: אִם יֵ֛שׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֱמוּנָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: εἰ ἔστιν ποιῶν κρίμα καὶ ζητῶν πίστιν ,
traditions.KJV: if there be [ any ] that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth ;
and I will pardon it .

2.english_reference: And though they say , The LORD liveth

traditions.VUL: Quod si étiam Vivit Dóminus , díxerint :
traditions.KJV: And though they say , The LORD liveth ;

traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐν ψεύδεσιν ὀμνύουσιν ?
traditions.KJV: surely they swear falsely .

3.english_reference: O LORD , [ are ] not thine eyes upon the truth ?

traditions.WLC: יְהֹוָ֗ה עֵינֶי ךָ֮ הֲ ל֣וֹא לֶ אֱמוּנָה֒
traditions.LXX: Κύριε , οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου εἰς πίστιν ·
traditions.KJV: O LORD , [ are ] not thine eyes upon the truth ?

3.english_reference: thou hast stricken them , but they have not grieved

traditions.WLC: הִכִּ֤יתָה אֹתָ ם֙ וְֽ לֹא חָ֔לוּ
traditions.KJV: thou hast stricken them , but they have not grieved ;

3.english_reference: thou hast consumed them , [ but ] they have refused to receive correction

traditions.LXX: συνετέλεσας αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν δέξασθαι παιδείαν ,
traditions.VUL: attrivísti eos , et renuérunt accípere disciplínam :
traditions.KJV: thou hast consumed them , [ but ] they have refused to receive correction :

3.english_reference: they have made their faces harder than a rock

traditions.LXX: ἐστερέωσαν τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ πέτραν
traditions.KJV: they have made their faces harder than a rock ;
they have refused to return .

4.english_reference: Therefore I said , Surely these [ are ] poor ; they are foolish

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַךְ דַּלִּ֖ים הֵ֑ם נוֹאֲל֕וּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ εἶπα Ἴσως πτωχοί εἰσιν , διότι οὐκ ἐδυνάσθησαν ,
traditions.VUL: Ego autem dixi : Fórsitan páuperes sunt et stulti ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore I said , Surely these [ are ] poor ; they are foolish :

4.english_reference: for they know not the way of the LORD

traditions.KJV: for they know not the way of the LORD , [ nor ]

4.english_reference: [ nor ] the judgment of their God

traditions.KJV: the judgment of their God .

5.english_reference: I will get me unto the great men ,

traditions.WLC: אֵֽלֲכָה לִּ֤ י אֶל הַ גְּדֹלִים֙
traditions.KJV: I will get me unto the great men ,
and will speak unto them ;

5.english_reference: for they have known the way of the LORD ,

traditions.KJV: for they have known the way of the LORD , [ and ]

5.english_reference: [ and ] the judgment of their God :

traditions.KJV: the judgment of their God :

5.english_reference: but these have altogether broken the yoke ,

traditions.VUL: et ecce magis hi simul confregérunt iugum ,
traditions.KJV: but these have altogether broken the yoke , [ and ]
burst the bonds .

6.english_reference: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them ,

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּן֩ הִכָּ֨ ם אַרְיֵ֜ה מִ יַּ֗עַר
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἔπαισεν αὐτοὺς λέων ἐκ τοῦ δρυμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Idcírco percússit eos leo de silva ,
traditions.KJV: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them , [ and ]

6.english_reference: [ and ] a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ λύκος ἕως τῶν οἰκιῶν ὠλόθρευσεν αὐτούς ,
traditions.KJV: a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them ,

6.english_reference: a leopard shall watch over their cities :

traditions.LXX: καὶ πάρδαλις ἐγρηγόρησεν ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν ·
traditions.KJV: a leopard shall watch over their cities :

6.english_reference: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces :

traditions.WLC: כָּל הַ יּוֹצֵ֥א מֵ הֵ֖נָּה יִטָּרֵ֑ף
traditions.LXX: πάντες οἱ ἐκπορευόμενοι ἀπ᾽ αὐτῶν θηρευθήσονται ,
traditions.VUL: omnis , qui egréssus fúerit ex eis , capiétur :
traditions.KJV: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces :
because their transgressions are many , [ and ]
their backslidings are increased .

7.english_reference: How shall I pardon thee for this ?

traditions.WLC: אֵ֤י לָ זֹאת֙ אסלוח לָ֔ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Super quo propítius tibi esse pótero ?
traditions.KJV: How shall I pardon thee for this ?
thy children have forsaken me ,

7.english_reference: and sworn by [ them that are ] no gods :

traditions.LXX: καὶ ὤμνυον ἐν τοῖς οὐκ οὖσιν θεοῖς ·
traditions.VUL: et iurant in his , qui non sunt dii :
traditions.KJV: and sworn by [ them that are ] no gods :

7.english_reference: when I had fed them to the full ,

traditions.KJV: when I had fed them to the full ,
they then committed adultery ,

7.english_reference: and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots ’ houses .

traditions.KJV: and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots ’ houses .

8.english_reference: They were [ as ] fed horses in the morning :

traditions.VUL: Equi amatóres et emissárii facti sunt :
traditions.KJV: They were [ as ] fed horses in the morning :

8.english_reference: every one neighed after his neighbour ’s wife .

traditions.WLC: אִ֛ישׁ אֶל אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖ הוּ יִצְהָֽלוּ
traditions.LXX: ἕκαστος ἐπὶ τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἐχρεμέτιζεν .
traditions.VUL: unusquísque ad uxórem próximi sui hinniébat .
traditions.KJV: every one neighed after his neighbour ’s wife .

9.english_reference: Shall I not visit for these [ things ] ?

traditions.KJV: Shall I not visit for these [ things ] ?
saith the LORD :

9.english_reference: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם֙ בְּ ג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר כָּ זֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁ י
traditions.LXX: ἢ ἐν ἔθνει τοιούτῳ οὐκ ἐκδικήσει ἡ ψυχή μου ?
traditions.VUL: et in gente tali non ulciscétur ánima mea ?
traditions.KJV: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?

10.english_reference: Go ye up upon her walls ,

traditions.KJV: Go ye up upon her walls ,
and destroy ;

10.english_reference: but make not a full end :

traditions.KJV: but make not a full end :
take away her battlements ;

10.english_reference: for they [ are ] not the LORD’S .

traditions.KJV: for they [ are ] not the LORD’S .

11.english_reference: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me ,

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ בָג֨וֹד בָּגְד֜וּ בִּ֗ י בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּ בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה
traditions.VUL: Prævaricatióne enim prævaricáta est in me domus Israel , et domus Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me ,
saith the LORD .
They have belied the LORD ,

12.english_reference: and said , [ It is ] not he

traditions.KJV: and said , [ It is ] not he ;

12.english_reference: neither shall evil come upon us

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא תָב֤וֹא עָלֵ֨י נוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה
traditions.KJV: neither shall evil come upon us ;

12.english_reference: neither shall we see sword nor famine

traditions.WLC: וְ חֶ֥רֶב וְ רָעָ֖ב ל֥וֹא נִרְאֶֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ μάχαιραν καὶ λιμὸν οὐκ ὀψόμεθα ·
traditions.KJV: neither shall we see sword nor famine :

13.english_reference: And the prophets shall become wind

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ נְּבִיאִים֙ יִֽהְי֣וּ לְ ר֔וּחַ
traditions.LXX: οἱ προφῆται ἡμῶν ἦσαν εἰς ἄνεμον ,
traditions.KJV: And the prophets shall become wind ,

13.english_reference: and the word [ is ] not in them

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ דִּבֵּ֖ר אֵ֣ין בָּ הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ λόγος Κυρίου οὐχ ὑπῆρχεν ἐν αὐτοῖς ·
traditions.VUL: et respónsum non fuit in eis :
traditions.KJV: and the word [ is ] not in them :

13.english_reference: thus shall it be done unto them

traditions.KJV: thus shall it be done unto them .

14.english_reference: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ
traditions.KJV: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts ,

traditions.WLC: יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְ כֶ֔ם אֶת הַ דָּבָ֖ר הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἐλαλήσατε τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο
traditions.KJV: Because ye speak this word ,

14.english_reference: behold , I will make my words in thy mouth fire

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ דְּבָרַ֨ י בְּ פִ֜י ךָ לְ אֵ֗שׁ
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δέδωκα τοὺς λόγους μου εἰς τὸ στόμα σου πῦρ ,
traditions.VUL: ecce ego do verba mea in ore tuo in ignem ,
traditions.KJV: behold , I will make my words in thy mouth fire ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ עָ֥ם הַ זֶּ֛ה עֵצִ֖ים
traditions.KJV: and this people wood ,
and it shall devour them .

15.english_reference: Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֣י מֵבִיא֩ עֲלֵי כֶ֨ם גּ֧וֹי מִ מֶּרְחָ֛ק בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς ἔθνος πόρρωθεν , οἶκος Ἰσραήλ , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego addúcam super vos gentem de longínquo domus Israel , ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the LORD :

15.english_reference: it [ is ] a mighty nation , it [ is ] an ancient nation

traditions.WLC: גּ֣וֹי אֵיתָ֣ן ה֗וּא גּ֤וֹי מֵ עוֹלָם֙ ה֔וּא
traditions.KJV: it [ is ] a mighty nation , it [ is ] an ancient nation ,

15.english_reference: a nation whose language thou knowest not

traditions.LXX: ἔθνος οὗ οὐκ ἀκούσει τῆς φωνῆς τῆς γλώσσης αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.KJV: a nation whose language thou knowest not ,
neither understandest what they say .

16.english_reference: Their quiver [ is ] as an open sepulchre

traditions.KJV: Their quiver [ is ] as an open sepulchre ,

traditions.LXX: πάντες ἰσχυροί , καὶ κατέδονται τὸν θερισμὸν ὑμῶν .
traditions.KJV: they [ are ] all mighty men .

17.english_reference: And they shall eat up thine harvest , and thy bread

traditions.WLC: וְ אָכַ֨ל קְצִֽירְ ךָ֜ וְ לַחְמֶ֗ ךָ
traditions.VUL: Et cómedet ségetes tuas , et panem tuum :
traditions.KJV: And they shall eat up thine harvest , and thy bread , [ which ]

17.english_reference: [ which ] thy sons and thy daughters should eat

traditions.WLC: יֹאכְלוּ֙ בָּנֶ֣י ךָ וּ בְנוֹתֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέδονται τοὺς υἱοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: devorábit fílios tuos , et fílias tuas :
traditions.KJV: thy sons and thy daughters should eat :

17.english_reference: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds

traditions.WLC: יֹאכַ֤ל צֹאנְ ךָ֙ וּ בְקָרֶ֔ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέδονται τὰ πρόβατα ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς μόσχους ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: cómedet gregem tuum , et arménta tua :
traditions.KJV: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds :

17.english_reference: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees

traditions.WLC: יֹאכַ֥ל גַּפְנְ ךָ֖ וּ תְאֵנָתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέδονται τοὺς ἀμπελῶνας ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς συκῶνας ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἐλαιῶνας ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: cómedet víneam tuam , et ficum tuam :
traditions.KJV: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees :

17.english_reference: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities , wherein thou trustedst , with the sword

traditions.WLC: יְרֹשֵׁ֞שׁ עָרֵ֣י מִבְצָרֶ֗י ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בָּ הֵ֖נָּה בֶּ חָֽרֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀλοήσουσιν τὰς πόλεις , τὰς πόλεις τὰς ὀχυρὰς ὑμῶν , ἐφ᾽ αἷς ὑμεῖς πεποίθατε ἐπ᾽ αὐταῖς , ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ .
traditions.VUL: et cónteret urbes munítas tuas , in quibus tu habes fidúciam , gládio .
traditions.KJV: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities , wherein thou trustedst , with the sword .

18.english_reference: Nevertheless in those days , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֛ם בַּ יָּמִ֥ים הָ הֵ֖מָּה נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις , λέγει Κύριος ὁ θεός σου ,
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen in diébus illis , ait Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless in those days , saith the LORD ,

18.english_reference: I will not make a full end with you

traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς εἰς συντέλειαν .
traditions.KJV: I will not make a full end with you .

19.english_reference: And it shall come to pass , when ye shall say , Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these [ things ] unto us ?

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ תַּ֣חַת מֶ֗ה עָשָׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛י נוּ לָ֖ נוּ אֶת כָּל אֵ֑לֶּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν εἴπητε Τίνος ἕνεκεν ἐποίησεν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἡμῖν πάντα ταῦτα ?
traditions.VUL: Quod si dixéritis : Quare fecit nobis Dóminus Deus noster hæc ómnia ?
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass , when ye shall say , Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these [ things ] unto us ?
then shalt thou answer them ,

19.english_reference: Like as ye have forsaken me , and served strange gods in your land

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִ י֙ וַ תַּעַבְד֞וּ אֱלֹהֵ֤י נֵכָר֙ בְּ אַרְצְ כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἐδουλεύσατε θεοῖς ἀλλοτρίοις ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Sicut dereliquístis me , et servístis deo aliéno in terra vestra ,
traditions.KJV: Like as ye have forsaken me , and served strange gods in your land ,

19.english_reference: so shall ye serve strangers in a land [ that is ] not yours

traditions.WLC: כֵּ֚ן תַּעַבְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים בְּ אֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: οὕτως δουλεύσετε ἀλλοτρίοις ἐν γῇ οὐχ ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: sic serviétis aliénis in terra non vestra .
traditions.KJV: so shall ye serve strangers in a land [ that is ] not yours .

20.english_reference: Declare this in the house of Jacob

traditions.LXX: Ἀναγγείλατε ταῦτα εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ἰακώβ ,
traditions.KJV: Declare this in the house of Jacob ,

20.english_reference: and publish it in Judah , saying

traditions.WLC: וְ הַשְׁמִיע֥וּ הָ בִ יהוּדָ֖ה לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.VUL: et audítum fácite in Iuda , dicéntes :
traditions.KJV: and publish it in Judah , saying ,
Hear now this ,
O foolish people ,
and without understanding ;

21.english_reference: which have eyes, and see not

traditions.WLC: עֵינַ֤יִם לָ הֶם֙ וְ לֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ
traditions.KJV: which have eyes , and see not ;

21.english_reference: which have ears, and hear not

traditions.WLC: אָזְנַ֥יִם לָ הֶ֖ם וְ לֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽעוּ
traditions.KJV: which have ears , and hear not :
Fear ye not me ?
saith the LORD :

22.english_reference: will ye not tremble at my presence

traditions.WLC: אִ֤ם מִ פָּנַ י֙ לֹ֣א תָחִ֔ילוּ
traditions.LXX: ἢ ἀπὸ προσώπου μου οὐκ εὐλαβηθήσεσθε ?
traditions.VUL: et a fácie mea non dolébitis ?
traditions.KJV: will ye not tremble at my presence ,

22.english_reference: which have placed the sand [ for ] the bound of the sea

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֤מְתִּי חוֹל֙ גְּב֣וּל לַ יָּ֔ם
traditions.LXX: τὸν τάξαντα ἄμμον ὅριον τῇ θαλάσσῃ ,
traditions.KJV: which have placed the sand [ for ] the bound of the sea
by a perpetual decree ,

22.english_reference: that it can not pass it

traditions.KJV: that it can not pass it :

22.english_reference: and though the waves thereof toss themselves

traditions.KJV: and though the waves thereof toss themselves ,
yet can they not prevail ;
though they roar ,

22.english_reference: yet can they not pass over it ?

traditions.KJV: yet can they not pass over it ?

23.english_reference: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart

traditions.WLC: וְ לָ עָ֤ם הַ זֶּה֙ הָיָ֔ה לֵ֖ב סוֹרֵ֣ר וּ מוֹרֶ֑ה
traditions.LXX: τῷ δὲ λαῷ τούτῳ ἐγενήθη καρδία ἀνήκοος καὶ ἀπειθής ,
traditions.VUL: Pópulo autem huic factum est cor incrédulum et exásperans ,
traditions.KJV: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart ;
they are revolted and gone .

24.english_reference: Neither say they in their heart

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא אָמְר֣וּ בִ לְבָבָ֗ ם
traditions.VUL: Et non dixérunt in corde suo :
traditions.KJV: Neither say they in their heart ,

24.english_reference: Let us now fear the LORD our God

traditions.WLC: נִ֤ירָא נָא֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.KJV: Let us now fear the LORD our God ,

24.english_reference: that giveth rain, both the former and the latter
